brief_history_append:
## 2026-11-20 — administrative clarification of overprint rationale

The v08 history above described the readers' old-before-new folio notation as three successive digits. That wording is corrected here: convention 4 explicitly permits an overwritten older form to be placed as deleted text immediately before the live form, so the notation itself does not assert three manuscript positions. The retained scan071 D26 difference concerns the folio's broad cancellation and certainty; the `\rlap` placement alone is formatting. D27 differs by allowing Phi-only retracing, with its `\rlap` placement also formatting. The related scan065 D017, scan068 D048 and scan070 D027 record prose now identifies the actual letter/state alternatives instead of treating old-before-live macro order as a spatial claim. No page text, final reading, source quotation, flag, count, crop, or ink judgment changed. The original brief files remain unchanged as historical versions. Exact administrative changes and unchanged-file hashes are recorded in `decisions/overprint_record_wording_changes.json`; the retained script is `scripts/review_overprint_record_wording.py`.
